corrections.reason: Both visually (the horizontal cross-bar of 6th-order ት is clearly visible) and grammatically in Ge'ez ('ተገብረ መንክራት' - miracles were wrought, nominative plural subject of passive verb ተገብረ), the word is መንክራት.
The 2nd-order vowel mark on the right leg of ሡ is visible on the page, matching the plural Ge'ez verb 'ኀሠሡ' (they sought) and the corresponding Amharic translation in Col 2 L16 ('እንደ ፈለጉ').
The printed characters are 7th-order ጾ (ተራገጾ) and 6th-order ን (ጋኔን, without a 2nd-order hook), matching Col 2 L23 ('ጋኔን የሚያንዘፈዝፈው').

Visually the final character has the 2nd-order right-side stroke of ቱ (መዊቶቱ, 'his death'), which corresponds to the 3rd-person masculine singular possessive suffix in Ge'ez and 'የሞቱን ነገር' in Col 2 L24.
